newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil May pulp exports down 35 pct on 1996 - Abecel.
newsitem.headline: Brazil May pulp exports down 35 pct on 1996 - Abecel.

text.p: Brazilian pulp exports totalled 165,772 tonnes in May, down 35 percent from the same month last year due to shipping delays, the Brazilian Pulp Exporters' Association (Abecel) said in a statement.

In the first five months of this year, Brazilian exports were still showing a substantive increase over 1996 however, reaching 974,020 tonnes, up nine percent on the 892,130 tonnes exported in January to May 1996.
Europe continues the main buyer this year, importing a total of 377,113 tonnes to the end of May, followed by Asia (347,044 tonnes to end-May) and North America (211,009 tonnes).
Abecel consists of the country's five main pulp exporters - Aracruz Celulose SA, Bahia Sul Celulose SA, Cenibra, Jari Celulose SA and Riocell SA.
Production by the five firms in May fell 11 percent over the same month last year to 220,000 tonnes against 248,294 tonnes in May 1996 but was up from 196,404 tonnes in April this year.
